component.markup_html:
Software Categories

Built around the work your team actually does.

Some projects are brand-new products. Others are internal systems that quietly remove hours of manual work. Most sit between existing tools and make the business run with fewer gaps.

IoT & Connected Operations

Platforms that collect data from devices, equipment, vehicles, facilities, or field operations and turn it into alerts, dashboards, and automated workflows.

Sensors Telemetry Edge Devices Alerts

Microservices & APIs

Backend services that expose clean APIs, coordinate business logic, connect third-party systems, and create stable foundations for future product work.

REST APIs Event Flows Cloud Services Integration

Decision Dashboards

Dashboards that show what is happening now, what needs attention, and which decisions matter next. Built for operators, owners, and managers who need signal fast.

KPIs Operations Forecasts Reporting

ETL & Data Pipelines

Data movement and transformation systems that pull from messy sources, clean the data, enrich it, and deliver it where reporting, operations, or AI tools can use it.

ETL Data Sync Warehousing Validation

Customer & Partner Portals

Secure portals where customers, vendors, franchisees, or partners can submit requests, review status, upload files, approve work, and interact with your business.

Self-Service Approvals Documents Status

Internal Tools & Admin Systems

Operational tools for scheduling, quoting, dispatch, inventory, approvals, intake, review queues, support workflows, and the work that usually ends up in spreadsheets.

Admin UI Workflow Scheduling Queues

System Integrations

Connectors that move data between CRMs, accounting systems, payment platforms, ERPs, websites, spreadsheets, email tools, and industry-specific software.

CRM Accounting Payments ERP

AI-Enabled Workflow Software

Software that uses AI carefully inside a larger workflow: summarization, classification, routing, document review, content drafting, exception detection, and support triage.

Classification Summaries Routing Review

QA Automation Systems

AI-agent QA setups, smoke tests, regression checks, release-readiness reports, screenshot capture, and testing workflows for products that cannot afford quiet breakage.

AI Agents Regression Screenshots Reports
